item.title: [+1] RBI steps up overseas investment checks as rupee slides
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 13 reports from Bloomberg.com, BusinessLine, Business Standard and 10 more. Related: “RBI steps up scrutiny of large overseas investments as rupee slides”. Mixed: 12 reports point the other way. Turn: earlier readings (19 Oct) pointed the other way.

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — Pharma exporters gain

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
